description: Look up a US or French street address: house number, street, unit, city, state, postal code and registration status. Registration does not establish deliverability or verify an apartment. On supported US results, optional Deep includes electoral code, name and Congress number on paid plans; existing accounts retain their current Deep access.

address.description: Street address, e.g. 1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500

country.description: Country: US or FR. Use FR or a written France suffix for France. Defaults to US.

deep.description: Legacy profile request flag. API 2.1 paid plans include profile detail automatically. Existing access rules and explicit metered operations remain unchanged.
